args.title: Brightline Freight Newsletter Summary – Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: Highlighted this week's topic "Cold-chain logistics in 2026," linking to a main article and a related webinar/companion piece.
- Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data in real time; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: Pilots of this live-data-sharing approach cut claims by roughly a quarter, reinforcing the article's cost-saving findings.
